features.name: CameraFaceDetection
features.note: Structurally and behaviorally faithful: all three buttons (PhotoButton, VideoButton, FaceDetectionButton) plus PreviewControl/FacesCanvas are present in the WinUI UIA tree with correct AutomationIds, and all are disabled exactly as in the UWP golden because no camera hardware exists (no dead-control regression -- nothing responds in the UWP golden either). Downgraded to partial for a visual-fidelity defect: the WinUI page renders effectively blank where the UWP golden showed three visible (disabled) buttons. The defensive 'No camera device found' StatusText is set Foreground=White on a white background, so it is invisible, and the disabled buttons also render invisibly. The parity gate passed structurally (100), but the visual judgment of a blank-vs-populated frame caps this at partial.
